description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Join an early-stage healthtech team building personalized AI coaching experiences. As the founding backend and AI engineer, you will take a working prototype into a reliable production platform and shape its core architecture.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own the AI coaching engine, including agents, tool-calling, memory, personalization, and safety guardrails.

 - Build backend tools for configuring coaching behavior, prompts, voice and text interactions, and user management.

 - Turn prototype systems into reliable production services with monitoring, evaluations, cost and latency controls, and incident response.

 - Design clean architecture that supports rapid iteration while minimizing technical debt.

 - Work closely with the founding team to ship product improvements continuously.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - At least 3 years of full-time backend engineering experience, with strong product judgment and expert-level Python skills.

 - Experience building and shipping production systems with LLM APIs and agentic workflows, including tool-calling, memory management, and personalization.

 - Experience implementing AI safety guardrails or content moderation, and taking prototype or research systems into production.

 - Background shipping backend systems under ambiguity and time constraints, ideally at an early-stage startup or on a 0-to-1 product.

 - Familiarity with Firebase, GCP, or event-driven and serverless architectures.

 - Interest or experience in fitness, health, or wellness technology.


COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

Base salary is $120,000 to $220,000 annually, with significant equity and standard startup benefits. Visa sponsorship policy was not provided.


LOCATION

On-site in New York, New York, United States.
